headline: COPT Defense Properties Tops Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Estimates
summary: COPT Defense Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue and earnings that exceeded Wall Street estimates.
why: COPT Defense Properties is a real estate investment trust focused on specialized office and data center assets leased to US government and defense tenants.

impacts.name: COPT Defense Properties
impacts.why: Surpassing third-quarter consensus expectations demonstrates resilient defense real estate demand.
